description: In every model of \(Q\), the standard copy is closed under addition and multiplication.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.standard_copy_operations.{u} (M : Type u)
  [Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M]
  [M ⊨ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.Q] :
  (∀ a ∈ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.standardCopy M,
      ∀ b ∈ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.standardCopy M,
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.addValue M a b ∈
          Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.standardCopy M) ∧
    ∀ a ∈ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.standardCopy M,
      ∀ b ∈ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.standardCopy M,
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.mulValue M a b ∈
          Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.standardCopy M
